title: Word Ladder
description: Given two words, beginWord and endWord, and a dictionary wordList, return the number of words in the shortest transformation sequence from beginWord to endWord, where each transformed word must exist in wordList. Only one letter can be changed at a time. Return 0 if no such sequence exists.
